Design phase for Increment 1; current dates follow the existing summary.
1. Confirm user roles and account-access needs
Agree what pet owners, clinic staff, veterinarians and the clinic owner need at entry.
2. Plan the landing page and entry navigation
Lay out clinic information, service entry points, registration and sign-in links.
3. Design registration, sign-in and recovery screens
Prepare account forms, verification-code screens and clear feedback messages.
4. Plan Google sign-in and account linking
Decide how new and existing accounts connect to Google without duplicate accounts.
5. Plan account verification and recovery behavior
Define verification expiry, resending, password recovery and unavailable-service messages.
Coding phase for Increment 1; current dates follow the existing summary.
Present the clinic, service choices and account entry links.
Collect account details and display form validation.
3. Add email verification and code resending
Verify new accounts and handle incorrect or expired codes.
4. Build sign-in, sign-out and session handling
Keep authorized users signed in and return them to the correct dashboard.
Let users recover access using an email verification code.
6. Add administrator and veterinarian account creation
Allow the clinic owner to create authorized staff accounts.
7. Add Continue with Google and new-account onboarding
Support Google sign-in and completion of required registration details.
Connect matching accounts while preventing duplicate or conflicting links.
9. Add registration terms and account-state messages
Show consent/terms feedback and explain blocked or unverified account access.
Give users a useful recovery screen when the system cannot be reached.
Testing phase for Increment 1; current dates follow the existing summary.
1. Check registration details and duplicate accounts
Try valid and invalid registration details and existing email addresses.
2. Check verification codes and password recovery
Try correct, incorrect, expired and resent codes and successful password reset.
3. Check sign-in, sign-out and restricted accounts
Confirm valid access, expired sessions and blocked inactive accounts.
4. Check Google onboarding and account linking
Try new users, existing users, mismatched identities and duplicate links.
5. Review entry pages and correct user feedback issues
Try the public/account flow, recovery messages and user-reported problems.
